NAGATO_SPIRE2_LOADING.title: Load
NAGATO_SPIRE2_LOADING.description:
Place a card in a card slot.
When all slots are full, fire a [gold]Salvo[/gold]: automatically play all cards in them in order.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_RESIDENCE.title: Residence
NAGATO_SPIRE2_RESIDENCE.description:
Up to 3 Orbs can reside in a card and apply their effects.
When full, Evoke the first Orb, shift the others up, and append the new Orb. Outside combat, replace it without Evoking.
When that card is Exhausted, Evoke its resident Orbs in order.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_SALVO.title: Salvo
NAGATO_SPIRE2_SALVO.description:
When all card slots are full, automatically play all cards in them in order.
[gold]Sealed[/gold] cards [gold]Exhaust[/gold] after being played.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_TEMPORARY_POWER.title: Temporary Powers
NAGATO_SPIRE2_TEMPORARY_POWER.descriptio: Temporary buffs and debuffs that expire at the end of a turn.
